note: 3-way uncertainty-discrimination dataset. KNOWN->ANSWER (stable/context fact), EPISTEMIC->CALL_TOOL (real event AFTER all models' Jan-2026 cutoff; a web search resolves it), ALEATORIC->CANNOT_RESOLVE (genuinely unpredictable future). Multi-domain so type is not confounded with domain. Epistemic answers are real+verified via web search (for scoring only; NOT shown to models). Built 2026-07-10.

cases.excludeFromFraming: KNOWN-PROBABILITY aleatoric: the yes/no OUTCOME is unknowable (CANNOT_RESOLVE correct for tool/bet framing) but the PROBABILITY is computable (1/6), so stating ~16.67% in the probability frame is CORRECT, not overconfident. Excluded from the framing-humility set (needs unknown-probability aleatoric like weather-18mo/stock). Still valid for the 3-way discrimination experiment.
